text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated latency and 5xx spike in runtime canary (release/2026-03-wave-7). Affected region: us-west-2. TPS down ~30%. thread:1867894321

oncall-jamie: Oncall here — confirming. seeing latency jump on canary slice. starting live triage.

eng-chen: I see kernel fallback events in the canary logs right after deploy, looks like quantized kernel selector flipped to fallback. Paste of error window:

```
2026-03-12T09:12:43Z runtime kernel_selector: WARN fallback_to_generic_kernel reason=conv_kernel_mismatch model=redwood-3b quant=4bit
2026-03-12T09:12:44Z runtime batcher: INFO batch_size=1->32 sawtooth_start
2026-03-12T09:12:45Z runtime request: ERROR 503 duration_ms=1842
```

oncall-jamie: thanks, Chen. I'm cutting canary traffic to 0% now. flipping feature flag: release-wave-7.canary=true -> false (kill-switch).

opsbot: Executed: /flags/flip release-wave-7.canary=false by oncall-jamie at 2026-03-12T09:14:02Z :white_check_mark:

eng-chen: Good. Also disabling new kernel selector rollout: /orchestrator/rollout cancel kernel-selector-v2.

opsbot: Orchestrator: rollout kernel-selector-v2 cancelled by eng-chen at 2026-03-12T09:14:35Z

sre-maya: Noted. I'm watching infra metrics — eviction and prefetch queues spiked around the same time. Likely batching window increase + kernel fallback causing CPU hotpath.

support-luis: Heads up — Support is seeing 12 customers with errors since 09:12 UTC, a couple reported degraded SLAs. I've opened a shared doc for customer comms.

pm-ritu: Please add me to the customer doc, and we'll prep a brief. ETA for rollback confirmation?

oncall-jamie: Canary traffic fully cut at 09:14:05. Error rates starting to return to baseline for prod slices. I'll keep canary pinned to previous model version until postmortem.

eng-chen: Oncall, can you collect a KV cache dump from affected canary pods and save to s3://redwood-incident/1867894321/cache-dumps for further analysis?

oncall-jamie: Running command now:

```
kubectl exec -it canary-pod-7 -- /usr/local/bin/dump-kv --out /tmp/kv-dump.tar && aws s3 cp /tmp/kv-dump.tar s3://redwood-incident/1867894321/
```

opsbot: Task queued. Upload complete at 2026-03-12T09:18:22Z :white_check_mark:

eng-chen: Thanks. Preliminary hypothesis: kernel-selector v2 mis-evaluates certain attention shapes with 4-bit quant path, causing fallback to a slow generic kernel which increases tail latency and thrashes the batching window.

sre-maya: Mitigated by kill-switch. I'll keep an eye on autorecovery. Suggest we rollback the whole release to previous stable artifact in the next maintenance window if confidence remains low.

pm-ritu: Customer doc updated — initial hit list + timeline. We'll send an interim message: "We detected a canary rollout causing latency degradations; canary traffic has been disabled and we're investigating. No action required from customers."

support-luis: Sending now.

oncall-jamie: Handing off to day oncall (sre-maya) for further monitoring and triage. I'm going offline in 20m. All steps documented.

sre-maya: Taking over. I'll coordinate with Eng for root cause. Can someone assign a follow-up ticket for a rollback plan and regression test covering batch/window+quant combos?

eng-chen: I'll file RFC and ticket: INFRA-7321 with repro and logs. Also adding unit test to kernel-selector scoring.

pm-ritu: Keeping PM loop closed. We'll delay the broader rollout until fix and canary requalification.

support-luis: Noted. No escalations from customers yet beyond initial reports. Will update if anything new.

opsbot: Incident summary (auto): event=canary-latency-spike cause=suspected-kernel-fallback mitigation=canary-traffic-cut,rollout-cancelled status=monitoring start=2026-03-12T09:12:21Z ack=2026-03-12T09:13:50Z

sre-maya: Closing alerts for canary slice alerts but leaving incident channel open for RCA. If anyone sees reoccurrence after re-enable, ping immediately. :thumbsup:

eng-chen: Will work on patch, aiming for canary re-run with additional telemetry flags disabled.

pm-ritu: Thx all. I'll schedule a postmortem and customer follow-up draft for tomorrow.

oncall-jamie: Thanks team — oncall handoff complete. :slightly_smiling_face:
